title: ENFORCEMENT RULES OF THE KOREAN VETERANS ASSOCIATION ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korean Veterans Association Act and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Financial and Accounting Standards)
The Rules on the Finances and Accounting of Patriots and Veterans Organizations (excluding Article 17 and Article 18 (1)) shall apply mutatis mutandis to the standards for the finances and accounting of the Korean Veterans Association (hereinafter referred to as the "Veterans Association") under Article 16-2 of the Korean Veterans Association Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). In such cases, "patriots and veterans organizations" shall be construed as the "Veterans Association".

Article 3 (Reporting of Settlement of Accounts)
The "period prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs" in Article 16-3 (1) of the Act means 150 days.

Article 4 (Procedures for Approval of Profit-Making Projects, etc.)
(1) Where the Veterans Association intends to obtain approval for a profit-making project under Article 16-4 (1) of the Act, it shall submit an application for approval in attached Form 1 to the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, with the following documents attached. <Amended on July 11, 2025>
1. A business plan. The plan shall include the type of business and items involved in the profit-making project, the related operating facilities and personnel, a financing plan, and other relevant matters;
2. A written deliberation and resolution of the Welfare Projects Deliberative Committee in attached Form 2;
3. Documents proving that the qualifications necessary to conduct the profit-making project under the relevant statutes, such as authorization, permission, licensing, registration, and reporting, have been fulfilled;
4. A plan for the use of profits from the profit-making project;
5. Other documents required by the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs to verify compliance with the standards under Article 16-4 (3) of the Act and Article 6 (1) of these Rules.
(2) Where the Veterans Association intends to obtain approval for a modification of a profit-making project under the main clause of Article 16-4 (2) of the Act, it shall submit an application for approval for modification in attached Form 3 to the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, with the following documents attached. <Amended on July 11, 2025>
1. Documents proving the modifications;
2. A written deliberation and resolution of the Welfare Projects Deliberative Committee in attached Form 2;
3. Documents concerning modification of the business plan (only where the business plan is modified);
4. Documents proving that the qualifications necessary to conduct the profit-making project under the relevant statutes, such as authorization, permission, licensing, registration, and reporting, have been fulfilled (only where the type of business or items of the profit-making project are modified);
5. Documents concerning modification of the plan for the use of profits from the profit-making project (only where the plan for the use of profits is modified);
6. Other documents required by the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs in relation to approval for modification of the profit-making project.
(3) The public official in charge who receives an application under paragraph (1) or (2) shall verify the certificate of business registration, the certificate of registered matters concerning the building, and the certificate of registered matters concerning the land through joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act: Provided, That if the applicant does not consent to verification of the certificate of business registration, the official shall require the applicant to submit that document directly. <Added on July 30, 2026>
(4) Where the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs receives an application for approval or approval for modification of a profit-making project under paragraph (1) or (2), the Minister shall decide whether to grant approval or approval for modification and notify the Veterans Association within 30 days from the date of application. If the Minister decides to grant approval or approval for modification, the Minister shall issue a profit-making project approval certificate in attached Form 4 to the Veterans Association. <Amended on July 30, 2026>

Article 5 (Reporting of Modification of Approved Matters for Profit-Making Projects)
(1) The "minor approved matters prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs" in the proviso to Article 16-4 (2) of the Act means any of the following:
1. Matters concerning the location of a place of business related to the operation of the profit-making project;
2. Matters concerning the operating facilities or the scale of personnel related to the profit-making project.
(2) Where the Veterans Association intends to report a modification of approved matters under the proviso to Article 16-4 (2) of the Act, it shall submit a report of modification of a profit-making project in attached Form 5 to the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, with documents proving modifications falling under any of the subparagraphs of paragraph (1) attached.

Article 6 (Standards for Direct Production, etc.)
(1) The standards for direct production or provision under Article 16-4 (3) 2 of the Act are as follows:
1. A profit-making project in which the Veterans Association directly produces goods, having the facilities, personnel, and other requirements for direct production prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of SMEs and Startups and the Administrator of the Public Procurement Service under the Act on Facilitation of Purchase of Small and Medium Enterprise-Manufactured Products and Support for Development of Their Markets and the Government Procurement Act;
2. A profit-making project that directly provides services (용역) or service activities (서비스) (hereinafter referred to as "services, etc." in this Article), with the technology, personnel, and other requirements prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs.
(2) Where goods produced or services, etc. provided by the Veterans Association satisfy the standards under paragraph (1), the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs may issue a certificate confirming that fact as prescribed by the Minister: Provided, That competitive products designated under Article 6 of the Act on Facilitation of Purchase of Small and Medium Enterprise-Manufactured Products and Support for Development of Their Markets shall be excluded from issuance of the certificate.

Article 7 (Extension of the Period of Validity of Approval for Profit-Making Projects)
(1) Where the Veterans Association intends to obtain an extension of the period of validity of approval for a profit-making project under Article 16-4 (6) of the Act, it shall submit an application for extension of the period of validity in attached Form 6 to the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs no later than three months before the period of validity expires, with the following documents attached. In such cases, the public official in charge shall verify the certificate of business registration, the certificate of registered matters concerning the building, and the certificate of registered matters concerning the land through joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act; if the applicant does not consent to verification of the certificate of business registration, the official shall require the applicant to submit that document directly. <Amended on July 11, 2025; July 30, 2026>
1. A written deliberation and resolution of the Welfare Projects Deliberative Committee in attached Form 2;
2. Documents proving that the qualifications necessary to conduct the profit-making project under the relevant statutes, such as authorization, permission, licensing, registration, and reporting, have been fulfilled;
3. Other documents required by the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs to verify compliance with the standards under Article 16-4 (3) of the Act and Article 6 (1) of these Rules.
(2) Where necessary to verify whether the particulars of the application under paragraph (1) satisfy the standards under the subparagraphs of Article 16-4 (3) of the Act, the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs may conduct a documentary investigation, an on-site investigation, or a similar investigation: Provided, That where the Veterans Association submits a certificate of confirmation of direct production under Article 9 (4) of the Act on Facilitation of Purchase of Small and Medium Enterprise-Manufactured Products and Support for Development of Their Markets (limited to a certificate whose validity expires one year or more after the expiration date of the approval for the profit-making project), it shall be deemed to satisfy the facilities, personnel, and other standards for direct production under Article 16-4 (3) 2 of the Act and Article 6 (1) 1 of these Rules. <Amended on July 11, 2025>
(3) Where the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs determines that the particulars of the application under paragraph (1) satisfy the standards under the subparagraphs of Article 16-4 (3) of the Act, the Minister shall extend the period of validity for a period not exceeding three years: Provided, That the Minister may decline to extend the period of validity if a fact falling under any of the subparagraphs of Article 16-12 (1) of the Act exists in relation to the profit-making project.
(4) Upon receiving an application under paragraph (1), the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs shall decide whether to extend the period of validity and notify the Veterans Association within 60 days from the date of application. If the Minister decides to extend the period of validity, the Minister shall issue a profit-making project approval certificate in attached Form 4 to the Veterans Association. <Amended on July 11, 2025>
(5) No later than six months before the period of validity of approval for the profit-making project expires, the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs shall inform the Veterans Association, by text message, email, telephone, postal mail, or a similar means, that an extension of the period of validity cannot be obtained unless an application under paragraph (1) is made no later than three months before that period expires.

Article 8 (Terms of Office of Members of the Welfare Projects Deliberative Committee, etc.)
(1) The term of office of a member of the Welfare Projects Deliberative Committee under Article 16-6 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Deliberative Committee") shall be two years: Provided, That the term of office of a member who is a public official shall be the period during which that member holds the relevant position.
(2) The Deliberative Committee shall have one secretary to handle its affairs. The secretary shall be designated by the president of the Veterans Association from among its executive officers or employees.

Article 9 (Requests for Redeliberation by the Veterans Association, etc.)
(1) Where the Veterans Association requests redeliberation under the proviso to Article 16-6 (6) of the Act, it may do so within 10 days from the date it is notified of the Deliberative Committee’s deliberation and resolution, specifying the grounds for the request in detail. In such cases, Article 10 (2) through (7) shall apply mutatis mutandis to deliberation and resolution on matters for which redeliberation is requested.
(2) Upon receiving a request for redeliberation under the former part of paragraph (1), the Deliberative Committee shall notify the Veterans Association of the result within 30 days from the date it receives the request: Provided, That where unavoidable circumstances exist, it may extend the notification period by up to 30 days.

Article 10 (Operation of the Deliberative Committee)
(1) A meeting of the Deliberative Committee shall be convened where requested by the president of the Veterans Association or where the chairperson of the Deliberative Committee deems it necessary.
(2) If the chairperson intends to convene a meeting of the Deliberative Committee, the chairperson shall notify its members, in writing or by email, of the date, time, place, matters to be deliberated, and other relevant particulars no later than seven days before the meeting: Provided, That in urgent cases or where an unavoidable reason exists, the chairperson may give notice no later than the day before the meeting. <Amended on July 11, 2025>
(3) The Deliberative Committee may request the Veterans Association to submit materials where the Committee deems them necessary for deliberation and resolution. In such cases, the Veterans Association shall comply with the request unless there is a special reason not to do so.
(4) The Deliberative Committee shall notify the Veterans Association without delay of its deliberation and resolution on the agenda.
(5) Members attending a meeting of the Deliberative Committee may be paid allowances and travel expenses within the budget of the Veterans Association: Provided, That this shall not apply where a member who is a public official attends in direct connection with matters under that official’s jurisdiction.
(6) The secretary of the Deliberative Committee shall prepare and maintain minutes and an operations management register for the Welfare Projects Deliberative Committee in attached Form 8.
(7) Except as provided in paragraphs (1) through (6), matters necessary for the operation of the Deliberative Committee shall be determined by the president of the Veterans Association.

Article 11 (Timing of Accounting Audits, etc.)
(1) Under the former part of Article 16-9 (1) of the Act, the Veterans Association shall undergo an accounting audit by a certified accounting institution within three months after the end of each fiscal year. In such cases, the certified accounting institution shall prepare an audit report in accordance with the accounting audit standards under Article 16 of the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies, etc.
(2) The "profit-making projects of at least a certain scale prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs" in the latter part of Article 16-9 (1) of the Act means profit-making projects with annual sales of at least two billion won in the preceding year.
(3) The "period prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs" in the former part of Article 16-9 (2) of the Act means 30 days: Provided, That where unavoidable circumstances exist, the accounting audit period may be extended by up to 20 days.

Article 12 (Fact-Finding Surveys)
(1) The scope of a fact-finding survey on the operation of profit-making projects under Article 16-10 (1) of the Act shall be as follows:
1. The status of operation of profit-making projects, including employment, wages, factories, production facilities, and sales;
2. Verification of whether the standards for approval for profit-making projects continue to be met;
3. Details of the use of profits from profit-making projects;
4. The contents and terms of contracts related to profit-making projects;
5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs for the sound operation of profit-making projects.
(2) A fact-finding survey under paragraph (1) may be conducted through a documentary investigation, an on-site investigation, or a similar method.

Article 13 (Disclosure of Information and Materials)
(1) Where the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs discloses information or materials concerning the Veterans Association under Article 16-11 (1) of the Act, the Minister shall disclose them separately for each profit-making project.
(2) The "information or materials prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs" in Article 16-11 (1) 3 of the Act means the type of business and items of the profit-making project, the location of its place of business, and the period of validity of approval for the profit-making project.

Article 14 (Standards for Dispositions concerning Profit-Making Projects, etc.)
(1) The detailed standards for suspension of a profit-making project and revocation of approval under Article 16-12 (1) of the Act shall be as set out in the attached Table.
(2) Where the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs intends to allow continued performance of work under a contract concluded in relation to a profit-making project pursuant to Article 16-12 (2) of the Act, the Minister shall state the particulars in the written disposition when suspending the profit-making project or revoking its approval under paragraph (1) of that Article.
(3) The "period prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs" in Article 16-12 (3) of the Act means within one month from the date on which the Veterans Association is subject to a disposition suspending the profit-making project or revoking its approval under paragraph (1) of that Article.

Article 15 (Review of Regulations)
The Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs shall review the appropriateness of the following matters every three years, using January 16, 2024 as the base date (meaning before January 16 of each year in which three years have elapsed), and take measures such as improvement:
1. Fact-finding surveys under Article 12;
2. The detailed standards for suspension of profit-making projects and revocation of approval under Article 14 (1) and the attached Table.

Addenda <Ordinance No. 23, January 16, 2024>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Reports on the Performance of Profit-Making Projects)
Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 3 and Article 11 (1) and (2), Article 10 of the former Rules on Profit-Making Projects of the Korean Veterans Association shall apply to reports on the performance of the Veterans Association’s profit-making projects for the 2023 fiscal year.

Addenda <Ordinance No. 54, July 11, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Certificates of Extension of the Period of Validity of Approval for Profit-Making Projects)
Certificates of extension of the period of validity of approval for profit-making projects issued under the former provisions as at the time these Rules enter into force shall be deemed to be profit-making project approval certificates issued under the amended provisions of Article 7 (4) and attached Form 4.

Addenda <Ordinance No. 75, July 30, 2026>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Attached Table: Detailed Standards for Suspension of Profit-Making Projects and Revocation of Approval (Related to Article 14 (1))
1. General Standards
(a) Where there are two or more violations, the heavier disposition standard shall apply: Provided, That where two or more disposition standards are all suspensions, the heavier suspension shall be increased by up to one half of each of the other prescribed suspension periods, without exceeding the sum of all the prescribed periods.
(b) The standards for administrative dispositions according to the number of violations shall apply where an administrative disposition has been imposed for the same violation within the preceding three years. The period shall be calculated by reference to the date of the administrative disposition for the violation and the date on which the same violation committed again after that disposition is detected.
(c) Where an aggravated disposition is imposed under item (b), the level applied shall be the next level after that of the disposition preceding the violation (the highest level where two or more dispositions were imposed within the period specified in item (b)).
(d) The authority imposing the disposition may aggravate or mitigate it where any of the following grounds for aggravation or mitigation apply, taking into account the motive, nature, frequency, severity, and other circumstances of the violation. A suspension may be increased or reduced by up to one half of the period prescribed by the applicable standard. Revocation of approval (excluding cases under paragraph 2 (a), (b), and (e)) may be reduced to a six-month suspension.
  1) Grounds for aggravation:
    (a) Where the violation was intentional or resulted from gross negligence;
    (b) Where the violation seriously undermined order in the operation of profit-making projects.
  2) Grounds for mitigation:
    (a) Where the violation is recognized as having resulted from minor carelessness or error;
    (b) Where the violation caused only minor harm to order in the operation of profit-making projects.
(e) For a violation under paragraph 2 (d), (f), (g), (i), or (j), the authority imposing the disposition may order corrective measures in place of the suspension prescribed by the individual standards, only in the case of a first violation.

2. Individual Standards

| Violation | Legal basis in the Act | First violation | Second violation | Third violation | Fourth and subsequent violations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (a) Obtaining approval or approval for modification of a profit-making project under Article 16-4 (1) or (2) by fraud or other improper means | Article 16-12 (1) 1 | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval |
| (b) Discontinuing a profit-making project approved under Article 16-4 (1) | Article 16-12 (1) 2 | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval |
| (c) Failing to operate a profit-making project approved under Article 16-4 (1) for at least two years | Article 16-12 (1) 3 | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval |
| (d) Failing to satisfy the approval standards under Article 16-4 (3) | Article 16-12 (1) 4 | Suspension for 2 months | Suspension for 4 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of approval |
| (e) Lending the Veterans Association’s name to another person to conduct a profit-making project, in violation of Article 16-5 (1) | Article 16-12 (1) 5 | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval |
| (f) Refusing an accounting audit under Article 16-9 (1) or a regular audit under paragraph (5) of that Article, or submitting false materials | Article 16-12 (1) 6 | Suspension for 2 months | Suspension for 4 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of approval |
| (g) Refusing, obstructing, or evading a fact-finding survey under Article 16-10 (1) | Article 16-12 (1) 7 | Suspension for 2 months | Suspension for 4 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of approval |
| (h) Failing to comply with corrective measures under Article 17 | Article 16-12 (1) 8 | Suspension for 2 months | Suspension for 4 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of approval |
| (i) Refusing, obstructing, or evading an investigation or inspection under Article 17-2 (1) | Article 16-12 (1) 9 | Suspension for 2 months | Suspension for 4 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of approval |
| (j) Refusing to report or to submit documents or materials under Article 18, making a false report, or submitting false documents or materials | Article 16-12 (1) 10 | Suspension for 2 months | Suspension for 4 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of approval |
| (k) Operating a profit-making project during its suspension period | Article 16-12 (1) 11 | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval |
| (l) Being restricted from participation in bidding under Article 27 of the Act on Contracts to Which the State Is a Party | Article 16-12 (1) 12 | Suspension for 3 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval |
| (m) Being restricted from participation in bidding under Article 31 of the Act on Contracts to Which a Local Government Is a Party | Article 16-12 (1) 13 | Suspension for 3 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval |
| (n) Falling under Article 11 (2) 1 or 3 of the Act on Facilitation of Purchase of Small and Medium Enterprise-Manufactured Products and Support for Development of Their Markets | Article 16-12 (1) 14 | Suspension for 3 months | Suspension for 6 months | Revocation of approval | Revocation of approval |

Source Supplement: Amendment Text
Ordinance of the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs No. 75
The Ordinance Partially Amending the Enforcement Rules of the Korean Veterans Association Act is hereby promulgated as follows.
July 30, 2026
Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs (Seal)

Ordinance Partially Amending the Enforcement Rules of the Korean Veterans Association Act
The Enforcement Rules of the Korean Veterans Association Act are partially amended as follows:

Article 4 (3) shall be renumbered as paragraph (4), and paragraph (3) shall be newly inserted in that Article as follows:
(3) The public official in charge who receives an application under paragraph (1) or (2) shall verify the certificate of business registration, the certificate of registered matters concerning the building, and the certificate of registered matters concerning the land through joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act: Provided, That if the applicant does not consent to verification of the certificate of business registration, the official shall require the applicant to submit that document directly.

The following sentence shall be added to the portion of Article 7 (1) other than its subparagraphs:
In such cases, the public official in charge shall verify the certificate of business registration, the certificate of registered matters concerning the building, and the certificate of registered matters concerning the land through joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act; if the applicant does not consent to verification of the certificate of business registration, the official shall require the applicant to submit that document directly.

Attached Forms 1, 3, and 6 shall be replaced by the respective attached forms.

Addenda
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

[Partial Amendment]
Reasons for Amendment and Main Contents
The purpose is to reduce applicants’ burden of submitting documents by requiring the public official receiving an application by the Korean Veterans Association for approval of a profit-making project or a similar approval to verify the certificate of business registration, the certificate of registered matters concerning the building, and the certificate of registered matters concerning the land through joint use of administrative information.
[Provided by the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs]
